The Seminole receipts

  • $1,890 median rent a month

    Median rent in Seminole County, utilities included, is $1,890 a month. That’s more than Florida’s $1,812.

    Source: U.S. Census Bureau

  • 6 in 10 renters pay 30%+ of income on rent

    About 6 in 10 Seminole renters (60.9%) spend 30% or more of their income on rent and utilities. More than 1 in 4 (27.8%) spend half or more.

    Source: U.S. Census Bureau

  • $424,600 median home value

    34.9% of Seminole households rent. The median home is worth $424,600, above Florida’s $396,900.

    Source: U.S. Census Bureau
